topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When I heard about the neighbor's little gardening project, something in me warmed a bit. It’s a small request, really, just a corner of the yard. I can imagine the place already, bursting with green life, maybe a few tomatoes or some flowers. I told them they could, of course, and that I’d help clear the spot if they needed. It’s not just dirt and seeds; it’s a piece of trust, and I like the idea of growing something together. The yard will be a little more beautiful and a lot more lively. Plus, it’s nice to see someone excited about turning a small space into something special.
